collection.description: A villager with chronic pain refuses a coworker's offers to carry their tools.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A villager with chronic pain refuses a coworker's repeated offers to carry their tools. The coworker feels rejected.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They agree on specific tasks where assistance is welcome.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: A small design change reduces strain without requiring constant intervention.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The coworker backs off; later, the villager asks for help on their own terms.
